notes: Firebird 5 SuperServer. MVCC with SNAPSHOT / READ COMMITTED isolation, UPDATE OR INSERT and MERGE, no LATERAL/JSON. Built-in asynchronous replication (replication.conf + nbackup copy) exists since Firebird 4 but is not automated here. Loaded at scale 0.3 because firebird-driver executemany sends one row per round trip (a few thousand rows/s).

settings.firebird_conf:
AuditTraceConfigFile =/etc/firebird/fbtrace.conf
DefaultDbCachePages = 65536
WireCryptPlugin = ChaCha64, ChaCha, Arc4
WireCrypt = Enabled
# Trace configuration. Following rules are used :
# - configuration is processed from top to bottom
# - there is two kind of sections allowed : "database" and "services"
# - parameters at default section are used for all databases or services
# - only one default section for each kind is allowed
# - after processing of default database section, search is continued
# - if database name matches pattern, options are immediately applied and
#   search does not c

overhead.workload: SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE id = ?
overhead.full_logging: fbtracemgr -start user trace session with time_threshold=0 (every statement to full-trace.log)
